items.question: Trong câu "A project without phases is one lump of work whose success or failure you only discover at the last minute.", từ "lump" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A project without phases is one lump of work whose success or failure you only discover at the last minute.", what does "lump" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: lump /lʌmp/ (danh từ): khối, cục lớn. Cụm "one lump of work" chỉ một khối công việc liền, không chia nhỏ; "a lump sum" = một khoản tiền trả gọn một lần.
items.explanationEn: lump /lʌmp/ (noun): a solid mass or chunk. "One lump of work" is a single undivided mass of work; "a lump sum" is money paid all at once.

items.question: Trong câu "Phasing serves three purposes:", từ "serve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Phasing serves three purposes:", what does "serve" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to bring food to a table
to fulfil a purpose or need
to hit the ball to start
items.explanation: serve /sɜːrv/ (động từ): đáp ứng, phục vụ (mục đích). Cụm "serve a purpose" = đáp ứng một mục đích; khác với nghĩa "phục vụ đồ ăn" trong nhà hàng.
items.explanationEn: serve /sɜːrv/ (verb): to fulfil a purpose or need. "Serve a purpose" means to be useful for a specific aim, not the restaurant sense of serving food.

items.question: Trong câu "The end of each phase is a decision gate: continue, adjust, or stop.", từ "gate" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The end of each phase is a decision gate: continue, adjust, or stop.", what does "gate" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: gate /ɡeɪt/ (danh từ): điểm duyệt để đi tiếp. "Decision gate" hay "stage gate" là điểm duyệt cuối mỗi giai đoạn, nơi quyết định có đi tiếp hay không.
items.explanationEn: gate /ɡeɪt/ (noun): a checkpoint for approval. A "decision gate" or "stage gate" is a review point where the project is approved to continue or not.

items.question: Trong câu "The end of each phase is a decision gate: continue, adjust, or stop.", từ "adjust" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The end of each phase is a decision gate: continue, adjust, or stop.", what does "adjust" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: adjust /əˈdʒʌst/ (động từ): điều chỉnh. Hay gặp "adjust the plan / the budget" = điều chỉnh kế hoạch / ngân sách; danh từ: adjustment.
items.explanationEn: adjust /əˈdʒʌst/ (verb): to change slightly. Common in "adjust the plan / the budget"; the noun is "adjustment".

items.question: Trong câu "Each phase has its own deliverables, so no accountability gaps remain.", từ "deliverable" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each phase has its own deliverables, so no accountability gaps remain.", what does "deliverable" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an output that must be handed over
items.explanation: deliverable /dɪˈlɪv.ər.ə.bəl/ (danh từ): sản phẩm phải bàn giao. Từ rất phổ biến trong quản lý dự án: "project deliverables" là tài liệu, phần mềm… phải giao cho khách hàng.
items.explanationEn: deliverable /dɪˈlɪv.ər.ə.bəl/ (noun): an output that must be handed over. A core PM word: "project deliverables" are the documents, software, etc. promised to the customer.

items.question: Trong câu "Each phase has its own deliverables, so no accountability gaps remain.", từ "accountability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each phase has its own deliverables, so no accountability gaps remain.", what does "accountability" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: accountability /əˌkaʊn.təˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): trách nhiệm giải trình. "Accountability gap" = khoảng trống trách nhiệm, khi không ai chịu trách nhiệm về một việc; tính từ: accountable.
items.explanationEn: accountability /əˌkaʊn.təˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): responsibility for results. An "accountability gap" is when nobody is answerable for something; the adjective is "accountable".

items.question: Trong câu "It runs in parallel with execution from start to finish.", từ "in parallel" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It runs in parallel with execution from start to finish.", what does "in parallel" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in parallel /ɪn ˈpær.ə.lel/ (cụm từ): song song, cùng lúc. "Run in parallel with X" = diễn ra song song với X; trái nghĩa với "sequentially" (tuần tự).
items.explanationEn: in parallel /ɪn ˈpær.ə.lel/ (phrase): at the same time as. "Run in parallel with X" means happening at the same time as X; the opposite of "sequentially".

items.question: Trong câu "Drawing it as a sequential box is the single most common misreading of this model.", từ "sequential" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Drawing it as a sequential box is the single most common misreading of this model.", what does "sequential" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: sequential /sɪˈkwen.ʃəl/ (tính từ): tuần tự, nối tiếp. Danh từ: sequence (chuỗi, trình tự). "Sequential steps" = các bước làm lần lượt.
items.explanationEn: sequential /sɪˈkwen.ʃəl/ (adjective): following in order. The noun is "sequence". "Sequential steps" are done one after another.

items.question: Trong câu "Drawing it as a sequential box is the single most common misreading of this model.", từ "misreading" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Drawing it as a sequential box is the single most common misreading of this model.", what does "misreading" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: misreading /ˌmɪsˈriː.dɪŋ/ (danh từ): sự hiểu sai. Tiền tố "mis-" nghĩa là sai: misread, misunderstand, misjudge.
items.explanationEn: misreading /ˌmɪsˈriː.dɪŋ/ (noun): a wrong interpretation. The prefix "mis-" means wrongly: misread, misunderstand, misjudge.

items.question: Trong câu "70 percent of customers abandon their cart because they cannot pay on a phone", từ "abandon" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "70 percent of customers abandon their cart because they cannot pay on a phone", what does "abandon" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: abandon /əˈbæn.dən/ (động từ): bỏ dở, bỏ lại. Trong thương mại điện tử, "cart abandonment" = khách bỏ giỏ hàng không thanh toán.
items.explanationEn: abandon /əˈbæn.dən/ (verb): to leave unfinished. In e-commerce, "cart abandonment" means leaving a cart without paying.

items.question: Trong câu "If nobody can write down what success means, the project will succeed or fail depending on the mood of whoever judges it.", từ "mood" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If nobody can write down what success means, the project will succeed or fail depending on the mood of whoever judges it.", what does "mood" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: mood /muːd/ (danh từ): tâm trạng. Ý câu: không có tiêu chí viết ra thì thành bại tùy "tâm trạng" người đánh giá; "in a good mood" = đang vui.
items.explanationEn: mood /muːd/ (noun): a temporary state of mind. Without written criteria, success depends on the judge's mood; "in a good mood" means feeling happy.

items.question: Trong câu "A project without a real sponsor dies at the first obstacle.", từ "sponsor" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A project without a real sponsor dies at the first obstacle.", what does "sponsor" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a senior backer of a project
items.explanation: sponsor /ˈspɑːn.sɚ/ (danh từ): người bảo trợ dự án. "Project sponsor" là lãnh đạo cấp cao cấp tiền và gỡ vướng cho dự án; khác "sponsor" tài trợ sự kiện.
items.explanationEn: sponsor /ˈspɑːn.sɚ/ (noun): a senior backer of a project. A "project sponsor" is the senior person who funds and backs a project, unlike an event sponsor.

items.question: Trong câu "A project without a real sponsor dies at the first obstacle.", từ "obstacle" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A project without a real sponsor dies at the first obstacle.", what does "obstacle" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: obstacle /ˈɑːb.stə.kəl/ (danh từ): trở ngại. Hay gặp "overcome an obstacle" = vượt qua trở ngại.
items.explanationEn: obstacle /ˈɑːb.stə.kəl/ (noun): something that blocks progress. Common collocation: "overcome an obstacle".

items.question: Trong câu "Someone who can approve budget and resolve conflict between departments.", từ "approve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Someone who can approve budget and resolve conflict between departments.", what does "approve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: approve /əˈpruːv/ (động từ): phê duyệt. "Approve a budget / a request" = phê duyệt ngân sách / yêu cầu; danh từ: approval.
items.explanationEn: approve /əˈpruːv/ (verb): to officially accept. "Approve a budget / a request"; the noun is "approval".

items.question: Trong câu "Someone who can approve budget and resolve conflict between departments.", từ "resolve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Someone who can approve budget and resolve conflict between departments.", what does "resolve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: resolve /rɪˈzɑːlv/ (động từ): giải quyết (mâu thuẫn). "Resolve a conflict / an issue" = giải quyết xung đột / vấn đề; danh từ: resolution.
items.explanationEn: resolve /rɪˈzɑːlv/ (verb): to settle a problem. "Resolve a conflict / an issue"; the noun is "resolution".

items.question: Trong câu "The budget ceiling, the immovable deadline, the mandated technology, the person going on maternity leave in June.", từ "ceiling" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The budget ceiling, the immovable deadline, the mandated technology, the person going on maternity leave in June.", what does "ceiling" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the top surface of a room
items.explanation: ceiling /ˈsiː.lɪŋ/ (danh từ): mức trần, giới hạn trên. "Budget ceiling" = mức ngân sách tối đa không được vượt; trái nghĩa "floor" (mức sàn).
items.explanationEn: ceiling /ˈsiː.lɪŋ/ (noun): an upper limit. A "budget ceiling" is the maximum that may be spent; the opposite is a "floor".

items.question: Trong câu "The budget ceiling, the immovable deadline, the mandated technology, the person going on maternity leave in June.", từ "immovable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The budget ceiling, the immovable deadline, the mandated technology, the person going on maternity leave in June.", what does "immovable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: immovable /ɪˈmuː.və.bəl/ (tính từ): không thể dời lại. "An immovable deadline" = hạn chót cố định, không lùi được (vd. ngày ra luật mới).
items.explanationEn: immovable /ɪˈmuː.və.bəl/ (adjective): impossible to change or move. "An immovable deadline" is a fixed date that cannot slip, such as a legal launch date.

items.question: Trong câu "The budget ceiling, the immovable deadline, the mandated technology, the person going on maternity leave in June.", từ "mandated" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The budget ceiling, the immovable deadline, the mandated technology, the person going on maternity leave in June.", what does "mandated" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: mandated /ˈmæn.deɪ.tɪd/ (tính từ): bị bắt buộc sử dụng. Động từ "mandate" = bắt buộc; "a mandated technology" là công nghệ công ty ép phải dùng.
items.explanationEn: mandated /ˈmæn.deɪ.tɪd/ (adjective): required by an authority. From the verb "mandate"; a "mandated technology" is one the organisation requires you to use.

items.question: Trong câu "The budget ceiling, the immovable deadline, the mandated technology, the person going on maternity leave in June.", từ "maternity leave" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The budget ceiling, the immovable deadline, the mandated technology, the person going on maternity leave in June.", what does "maternity leave" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: time off to have a baby
items.explanation: maternity leave /məˈtɝː.nə.ti liːv/ (cụm từ): nghỉ thai sản. "Go on maternity leave" = đi nghỉ thai sản; tương tự "sick leave", "annual leave".
items.explanationEn: maternity leave /məˈtɝː.nə.ti liːv/ (phrase): time off to have a baby. "Go on maternity leave"; similar terms are "sick leave" and "annual leave".

items.question: Trong câu "The project charter summarises all of that, usually in two to three pages.", từ "summarise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The project charter summarises all of that, usually in two to three pages.", what does "summarise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: summarise /ˈsʌm.ə.raɪz/ (động từ): tóm tắt. Anh-Anh viết "summarise", Anh-Mỹ viết "summarize"; danh từ: summary.
items.explanationEn: summarise /ˈsʌm.ə.raɪz/ (verb): to give the main points. British spelling "summarise", American "summarize"; the noun is "summary".

items.question: Trong câu "The project charter summarises all of that, usually in two to three pages.", từ "charter" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The project charter summarises all of that, usually in two to three pages.", what does "charter" (noun) mean?
options: văn bản khởi động dự án
items.explanation: charter /ˈtʃɑːr.t̬ɚ/ (danh từ): văn bản khởi động dự án. "Project charter" chính thức cho phép dự án bắt đầu và trao quyền cho PM; nghĩa khác: "charter flight".
items.explanationEn: charter /ˈtʃɑːr.t̬ɚ/ (noun): a document authorising a project. A "project charter" formally authorises a project and the PM; another sense is a "charter flight".

items.question: Trong câu "Its role is giving the PM authority to act and giving everyone a shared reference when scope is argued about later.", từ "authority" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Its role is giving the PM authority to act and giving everyone a shared reference when scope is argued about later.", what does "authority" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: authority /əˈθɔːr.ə.t̬i/ (danh từ): quyền hạn. "Authority to act" = quyền được hành động; "the authorities" (số nhiều) lại là cơ quan nhà nước.
items.explanationEn: authority /əˈθɔːr.ə.t̬i/ (noun): the power to decide. "Authority to act" is the power to take decisions; "the authorities" means official bodies.

items.question: Trong câu "Its role is giving the PM authority to act and giving everyone a shared reference when scope is argued about later.", từ "reference" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Its role is giving the PM authority to act and giving everyone a shared reference when scope is argued about later.", what does "reference" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: reference /ˈref.ɚ.əns/ (danh từ): điểm tham chiếu chung. "A shared reference" = tài liệu mọi người cùng dựa vào khi tranh cãi; trong lập trình "reference" lại là tham chiếu.
items.explanationEn: reference /ˈref.ɚ.əns/ (noun): a source to check against. "A shared reference" is a document everyone checks against; in programming it means a pointer-like link.

items.question: Trong câu "You end up with a beautiful plan for solving the wrong thing.", từ "end up" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You end up with a beautiful plan for solving the wrong thing.", what does "end up" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to finally be in a situation
items.explanation: end up /end ʌp/ (cụm từ): rốt cuộc lại (có/bị). "End up with / end up doing" = cuối cùng lại rơi vào kết quả (thường ngoài ý muốn).
items.explanationEn: end up /end ʌp/ (phrase): to finally be in a situation. "End up with / end up doing" describes an eventual, often unintended, result.

items.question: Trong câu "The most expensive mistake in this phase: jumping into detailed planning before knowing the real problem.", từ "jump into" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most expensive mistake in this phase: jumping into detailed planning before knowing the real problem.", what does "jump into" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: jump into /dʒʌmp ˈɪn.tuː/ (cụm từ): lao vào vội vàng. "Jump into something" = lao vào làm ngay mà không suy nghĩ; gần nghĩa "rush into".
items.explanationEn: jump into /dʒʌmp ˈɪn.tuː/ (phrase): to start hastily. "Jump into something" means to start it without thinking first; similar to "rush into".

items.question: Trong câu "The output of planning is more than a schedule.", từ "schedule" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The output of planning is more than a schedule.", what does "schedule" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: schedule /ˈskedʒ.uːl/ (danh từ): lịch tiến độ. "Behind / ahead of schedule" = chậm / vượt tiến độ; "on schedule" = đúng tiến độ.
items.explanationEn: schedule /ˈskedʒ.uːl/ (noun): a timetable of planned work. "Behind / ahead of schedule" means late / early; "on schedule" means on time.

items.question: Trong câu "The output of planning is more than a schedule.", từ "output" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The output of planning is more than a schedule.", what does "output" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: output /ˈaʊt.pʊt/ (danh từ): kết quả đầu ra. Trái nghĩa với "input"; "the output of planning" = những gì giai đoạn lập kế hoạch tạo ra.
items.explanationEn: output /ˈaʊt.pʊt/ (noun): what a process produces. The opposite of "input"; "the output of planning" is what planning produces.

items.question: Trong câu "Scope and exclusions, written explicitly.", từ "exclusion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Scope and exclusions, written explicitly.", what does "exclusion" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: exclusion /ɪkˈskluː.ʒən/ (danh từ): hạng mục loại trừ. "Exclusions" trong phạm vi dự án = những việc KHÔNG làm; động từ: exclude.
items.explanationEn: exclusion /ɪkˈskluː.ʒən/ (noun): something left out. In scope, "exclusions" list what will NOT be done; the verb is "exclude".

items.question: Trong câu "Scope and exclusions, written explicitly.", từ "explicitly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Scope and exclusions, written explicitly.", what does "explicitly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: explicitly /ɪkˈsplɪs.ɪt.li/ (trạng từ): một cách rõ ràng. Trái nghĩa "implicitly" (ngầm); "state explicitly" = nói rõ ra.
items.explanationEn: explicitly /ɪkˈsplɪs.ɪt.li/ (adverb): clearly and directly. The opposite of "implicitly"; "state explicitly" means say it clearly.

items.question: Trong câu "A WBS — work broken down far enough to estimate and assign.", từ "break down" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A WBS — work broken down far enough to estimate and assign.", what does "break down" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: break down /breɪk daʊn/ (cụm từ): chia nhỏ ra. "Break down work into tasks" = chia công việc thành các task; nghĩa khác: "the car broke down" (xe hỏng).
items.explanationEn: break down /breɪk daʊn/ (phrase): to divide into parts. "Break work down into tasks"; another sense is "the car broke down" (stopped working).

items.question: Trong câu "A WBS — work broken down far enough to estimate and assign.", từ "estimate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A WBS — work broken down far enough to estimate and assign.", what does "estimate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: estimate /ˈes.tə.meɪt/ (động từ): ước tính. Động từ /ˈes.tə.meɪt/, danh từ "estimate" /ˈes.tə.mət/; "estimate effort / cost".
items.explanationEn: estimate /ˈes.tə.meɪt/ (verb): to roughly calculate. Verb /ˈes.tə.meɪt/, noun /ˈes.tə.mət/; used as "estimate effort / cost".

items.question: Trong câu "A WBS — work broken down far enough to estimate and assign.", từ "assign" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A WBS — work broken down far enough to estimate and assign.", what does "assign" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to give a task to someone
items.explanation: assign /əˈsaɪn/ (động từ): giao (việc) cho ai. "Assign a task to someone" = giao việc; trong lập trình "assign" là gán giá trị.
items.explanationEn: assign /əˈsaɪn/ (verb): to give a task to someone. "Assign a task to someone"; in programming "assign" means to set a variable's value.

items.question: Trong câu "A schedule with dependencies and the critical path.", từ "dependency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A schedule with dependencies and the critical path.", what does "dependency" (noun) mean?
options: sự phụ thuộc giữa công việc
optionsEn: a link where one task needs another
items.explanation: dependency /dɪˈpen.dən.si/ (danh từ): sự phụ thuộc giữa công việc. Trong lịch dự án, "dependency" = việc B chỉ làm được khi việc A xong.
items.explanationEn: dependency /dɪˈpen.dən.si/ (noun): a link where one task needs another. In a schedule, a "dependency" means task B cannot start until task A is done.

items.question: Trong câu "A schedule with dependencies and the critical path.", từ "critical path" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A schedule with dependencies and the critical path.", what does "critical path" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: the longest chain setting the end date
items.explanation: critical path /ˈkrɪt̬.ɪ.kəl pæθ/ (cụm từ): đường găng của tiến độ. "Critical path" (đường găng) là chuỗi việc dài nhất; trễ một ngày trên đó là trễ cả dự án.
items.explanationEn: critical path /ˈkrɪt̬.ɪ.kəl pæθ/ (phrase): the longest chain setting the end date. The "critical path" is the longest task chain; any delay on it delays the whole project.

items.question: Trong câu "A budget with contingency.", từ "contingency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A budget with contingency.", what does "contingency" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: contingency /kənˈtɪn.dʒən.si/ (danh từ): khoản dự phòng. "Contingency reserve / contingency plan" = khoản / kế hoạch dự phòng cho rủi ro.
items.explanationEn: contingency /kənˈtɪn.dʒən.si/ (noun): a reserve for unexpected events. "Contingency reserve / contingency plan" is kept for risks that may happen.

items.question: Trong câu "Acceptance criteria for each deliverable.", từ "acceptance criteria" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Acceptance criteria for each deliverable.", what does "acceptance criteria" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: acceptance criteria /əkˈsep.təns kraɪˈtɪr.i.ə/ (cụm từ): tiêu chí nghiệm thu. "Criteria" là số nhiều của "criterion"; tiêu chí nghiệm thu quyết định khi nào sản phẩm được coi là xong.
items.explanationEn: acceptance criteria /əkˈsep.təns kraɪˈtɪr.i.ə/ (phrase): conditions to accept a deliverable. "Criteria" is the plural of "criterion"; they define when a deliverable counts as done.

items.question: Trong câu "The rolling wave principle: detailed for the next two to three months, coarser beyond.", từ "coarse" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The rolling wave principle: detailed for the next two to three months, coarser beyond.", what does "coarse" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: coarse /kɔːrs/ (tính từ): sơ lược, ít chi tiết. "Coarse-grained" = mức chi tiết thô; trái nghĩa "fine-grained". Đồng âm với "course".
items.explanationEn: coarse /kɔːrs/ (adjective): less detailed, rough. "Coarse-grained" is the opposite of "fine-grained"; it sounds the same as "course".

items.question: Trong câu "The rolling wave principle: detailed for the next two to three months, coarser beyond.", từ "principle" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The rolling wave principle: detailed for the next two to three months, coarser beyond.", what does "principle" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: principle /ˈprɪn.sə.pəl/ (danh từ): nguyên tắc. Đừng nhầm với "principal" (hiệu trưởng, vốn gốc) dù phát âm giống nhau.
items.explanationEn: principle /ˈprɪn.sə.pəl/ (noun): a basic rule. Do not confuse with "principal" (head teacher, loan capital), which sounds the same.

items.question: Trong câu "Planning month eleven in detail is waste, because by then every assumption has changed.", từ "assumption" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Planning month eleven in detail is waste, because by then every assumption has changed.", what does "assumption" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the taking on of a role
items.explanation: assumption /əˈsʌmp.ʃən/ (danh từ): giả định. "Make an assumption" = đưa ra giả định; nghĩa khác "assumption of office" = nhậm chức.
items.explanationEn: assumption /əˈsʌmp.ʃən/ (noun): something taken as true. "Make an assumption"; another sense is "assumption of office", taking on a role.

items.question: Trong câu "The first risk that materialises makes you late immediately", từ "materialise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The first risk that materialises makes you late immediately", what does "materialise" (verb) mean?
options: xảy ra thật, thành hiện thực
items.explanation: materialise /məˈtɪr.i.ə.laɪz/ (động từ): xảy ra thật, thành hiện thực. "A risk materialises" = rủi ro thực sự xảy ra; Anh-Mỹ viết "materialize".
items.explanationEn: materialise /məˈtɪr.i.ə.laɪz/ (verb): to actually happen. "A risk materialises" when it actually happens; American spelling "materialize".

items.question: Trong câu "People do not commit to estimates they did not make", từ "commit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "People do not commit to estimates they did not make", what does "commit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: commit /kəˈmɪt/ (động từ): cam kết. "Commit to something" = cam kết thực hiện; danh từ: commitment.
items.explanationEn: commit /kəˈmɪt/ (verb): to promise to stick to. "Commit to something" means to promise to do it; the noun is "commitment".

items.question: Trong câu "On the people constraint: adding people to a late project usually makes it later, because newcomers must be trained by exactly the people who are already the bottleneck, and communication channels grow with the square of team size.", từ "newcomer" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On the people constraint: adding people to a late project usually makes it later, because newcomers must be trained by exactly the people who are already the bottleneck, and communication channels grow with the square of team size.", what does "newcomer" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: newcomer /ˈnuːˌkʌm.ɚ/ (danh từ): người mới vào. Người mới cần được đào tạo, nên thêm người vào dự án trễ thường làm nó trễ hơn.
items.explanationEn: newcomer /ˈnuːˌkʌm.ɚ/ (noun): someone who has just joined. Newcomers need training, which is why adding people to a late project slows it further.

items.question: Trong câu "On the people constraint: adding people to a late project usually makes it later, because newcomers must be trained by exactly the people who are already the bottleneck, and communication channels grow with the square of team size.", từ "bottleneck" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On the people constraint: adding people to a late project usually makes it later, because newcomers must be trained by exactly the people who are already the bottleneck, and communication channels grow with the square of team size.", what does "bottleneck" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: bottleneck /ˈbɑːt̬.əl.nek/ (danh từ): điểm nghẽn. Nghĩa bóng: điểm hẹp làm chậm cả hệ thống, dùng cho người, quy trình hoặc server.
items.explanationEn: bottleneck /ˈbɑːt̬.əl.nek/ (noun): a point that slows everything. Figuratively, the narrow point that slows the whole flow, whether a person, process or server.

items.question: Trong câu "On the people constraint: adding people to a late project usually makes it later, because newcomers must be trained by exactly the people who are already the bottleneck, and communication channels grow with the square of team size.", từ "square" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On the people constraint: adding people to a late project usually makes it later, because newcomers must be trained by exactly the people who are already the bottleneck, and communication channels grow with the square of team size.", what does "square" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a shape with four equal sides
items.explanation: square /skwer/ (danh từ): bình phương (của số). "Grow with the square of" = tăng theo bình phương, tức tăng rất nhanh khi đội lớn lên.
items.explanationEn: square /skwer/ (noun): a number multiplied by itself. "Grow with the square of" means growing quadratically, very fast as the team gets bigger.

items.question: Trong câu "Clear impediments before they become delays.", từ "impediment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Clear impediments before they become delays.", what does "impediment" (noun) mean?
options: trở ngại cản trở công việc
items.explanation: impediment /ɪmˈped.ə.mənt/ (danh từ): trở ngại cản trở công việc. Từ hay dùng trong Scrum: Scrum Master "removes impediments" cho đội.
items.explanationEn: impediment /ɪmˈped.ə.mənt/ (noun): something blocking work. Common in Scrum, where the Scrum Master "removes impediments" for the team.

items.question: Trong câu "Shield the team from noise — surprise requests, unnecessary meetings, uncontrolled changes.", từ "shield" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Shield the team from noise — surprise requests, unnecessary meetings, uncontrolled changes.", what does "shield" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: shield /ʃiːld/ (động từ): che chắn, bảo vệ. "Shield someone from something" = che chắn ai khỏi điều gì.
items.explanationEn: shield /ʃiːld/ (verb): to protect from harm. "Shield someone from something" means to protect them from it.

items.question: Trong câu "Shield the team from noise — surprise requests, unnecessary meetings, uncontrolled changes.", từ "noise" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Shield the team from noise — surprise requests, unnecessary meetings, uncontrolled changes.", what does "noise" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: noise /nɔɪz/ (danh từ): việc gây xao nhãng. Nghĩa bóng: những thứ vụn vặt làm phân tán sự tập trung; nghĩa gốc là tiếng ồn.
items.explanationEn: noise /nɔɪz/ (noun): distracting interruptions. Figuratively, distractions that break focus; the literal sense is a loud sound.

items.question: Trong câu "Stop quality being sacrificed quietly as pressure rises.", từ "sacrifice" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Stop quality being sacrificed quietly as pressure rises.", what does "sacrifice" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to give up for something else
items.explanation: sacrifice /ˈsæk.rə.faɪs/ (động từ): hy sinh, đánh đổi. "Sacrifice quality for speed" = hy sinh chất lượng để lấy tốc độ.
items.explanationEn: sacrifice /ˈsæk.rə.faɪs/ (verb): to give up for something else. "Sacrifice quality for speed" means giving up quality to go faster.

items.question: Trong câu "Update the forecast continuously, rather than waiting for reporting milestones.", từ "forecast" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Update the forecast continuously, rather than waiting for reporting milestones.", what does "forecast" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: forecast /ˈfɔːr.kæst/ (danh từ): dự báo. "Weather forecast" = dự báo thời tiết; trong dự án là dự báo ngày xong và chi phí.
items.explanationEn: forecast /ˈfɔːr.kæst/ (noun): a prediction of the future. As in "weather forecast"; in projects it predicts the end date and cost.

items.question: Trong câu "Update the forecast continuously, rather than waiting for reporting milestones.", từ "milestone" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Update the forecast continuously, rather than waiting for reporting milestones.", what does "milestone" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: milestone /ˈmaɪl.stoʊn/ (danh từ): cột mốc quan trọng. "Reach a milestone" = đạt một cột mốc; nghĩa gốc là cột mốc ghi dặm đường.
items.explanationEn: milestone /ˈmaɪl.stoʊn/ (noun): a key point in progress. "Reach a milestone"; literally a stone marking distance on a road.

items.question: Trong câu "Control rests on three questions, asked often enough:", từ "rest on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Control rests on three questions, asked often enough:", what does "rest on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: rest on /rest ɑːn/ (cụm từ): dựa trên. "X rests on Y" = X dựa vào Y; gần nghĩa "depend on", "be based on".
items.explanationEn: rest on /rest ɑːn/ (phrase): to be based on. "X rests on Y" means X depends on Y; similar to "be based on".

items.question: Trong câu "Every report should end with a concrete recommendation", từ "recommendation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every report should end with a concrete recommendation", what does "recommendation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: recommendation /ˌrek.ə.menˈdeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): đề xuất, khuyến nghị. "Make a recommendation" = đưa ra đề xuất; động từ: recommend.
items.explanationEn: recommendation /ˌrek.ə.menˈdeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a suggested course of action. "Make a recommendation"; the verb is "recommend".

items.question: Trong câu "Every report should end with a concrete recommendation", từ "concrete" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every report should end with a concrete recommendation", what does "concrete" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: concrete /ˈkɑːn.kriːt/ (tính từ): cụ thể, rõ ràng. "Concrete example / action" = ví dụ / hành động cụ thể; nghĩa danh từ là bê tông.
items.explanationEn: concrete /ˈkɑːn.kriːt/ (adjective): specific and definite. "Concrete example / action" is specific; as a noun it means cement building material.

items.question: Trong câu "The percent-complete trap: work reported 90 percent done for three consecutive weeks is not actually 90 percent done.", từ "consecutive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The percent-complete trap: work reported 90 percent done for three consecutive weeks is not actually 90 percent done.", what does "consecutive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: consecutive /kənˈsek.jə.t̬ɪv/ (tính từ): liên tiếp. "Three consecutive weeks" = ba tuần liên tiếp; đồng nghĩa "in a row".
items.explanationEn: consecutive /kənˈsek.jə.t̬ɪv/ (adjective): following one after another. "Three consecutive weeks" means three weeks in a row.

items.question: Trong câu "The defence: count only 0 or 100 for each small unit of work, rather than accepting numbers in between.", từ "defence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The defence: count only 0 or 100 for each small unit of work, rather than accepting numbers in between.", what does "defence" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: defence /dɪˈfens/ (danh từ): cách phòng tránh. Anh-Anh "defence", Anh-Mỹ "defense"; ở đây là biện pháp chống lại cái bẫy báo cáo phần trăm.
items.explanationEn: defence /dɪˈfens/ (noun): a way to protect against. British "defence", American "defense"; here, a way to guard against the percent trap.

items.question: Trong câu "A PM who does not know their critical path is managing by feel.", từ "by feel" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A PM who does not know their critical path is managing by feel.", what does "by feel" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: by feel /baɪ fiːl/ (cụm từ): theo cảm tính. "Manage by feel" = quản lý theo cảm giác, không dựa trên số liệu.
items.explanationEn: by feel /baɪ fiːl/ (phrase): based on intuition. "Manage by feel" means relying on intuition rather than data.

items.question: Trong câu "The customer confirms in writing that deliverables meet the agreed criteria.", từ "confirm" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The customer confirms in writing that deliverables meet the agreed criteria.", what does "confirm" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to state that something is true
items.explanation: confirm /kənˈfɝːm/ (động từ): xác nhận. "Confirm in writing" = xác nhận bằng văn bản; danh từ: confirmation.
items.explanationEn: confirm /kənˈfɝːm/ (verb): to state that something is true. "Confirm in writing"; the noun is "confirmation".

items.question: Trong câu "The customer confirms in writing that deliverables meet the agreed criteria.", từ "in writing" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The customer confirms in writing that deliverables meet the agreed criteria.", what does "in writing" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in writing /ɪn ˈraɪ.t̬ɪŋ/ (cụm từ): bằng văn bản. Văn bản giúp tránh tranh cãi sau này; trái nghĩa "verbally" (bằng miệng).
items.explanationEn: in writing /ɪn ˈraɪ.t̬ɪŋ/ (phrase): in a written document. A written record avoids later disputes; the opposite is "verbally".

items.question: Trong câu "Documentation, access, training, and who is responsible for incidents once the project team disbands.", từ "incident" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Documentation, access, training, and who is responsible for incidents once the project team disbands.", what does "incident" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: incident /ˈɪn.sə.dənt/ (danh từ): sự cố (vận hành). Trong IT, "incident" là sự cố làm gián đoạn dịch vụ; "incident management" = quản lý sự cố.
items.explanationEn: incident /ˈɪn.sə.dənt/ (noun): an unplanned service problem. In IT, an "incident" is an event that disrupts a service; see "incident management".

items.question: Trong câu "Documentation, access, training, and who is responsible for incidents once the project team disbands.", từ "disband" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Documentation, access, training, and who is responsible for incidents once the project team disbands.", what does "disband" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: disband /dɪsˈbænd/ (động từ): giải tán. Dùng cho nhóm, đội, ban nhạc: "the team disbands" = đội giải tán.
items.explanationEn: disband /dɪsˈbænd/ (verb): to break up a group. Used for groups and bands: "the team disbands" means it breaks up.

items.question: Trong câu "Final payments, open purchase orders closed.", từ "purchase order" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Final payments, open purchase orders closed.", what does "purchase order" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: purchase order /ˈpɝː.tʃəs ˈɔːr.dɚ/ (cụm từ): đơn đặt mua hàng. Viết tắt "PO"; phải đóng các PO còn mở khi kết thúc dự án.
items.explanationEn: purchase order /ˈpɝː.tʃəs ˈɔːr.dɚ/ (phrase): an official order to buy. Often shortened to "PO"; open POs must be closed when the project ends.

items.question: Trong câu "State each person's last day and where they go next.", từ "state" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "State each person's last day and where they go next.", what does "state" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: state /steɪt/ (động từ): nêu rõ, tuyên bố. Động từ "state" = nói rõ, chính thức; danh từ "state" = trạng thái hoặc nhà nước.
items.explanationEn: state /steɪt/ (verb): to say clearly. The verb "state" means to declare clearly; the noun means condition or government.

items.question: Trong câu "Letting a team dissolve with nobody knowing their destination is a reliable way to lose your best people.", từ "dissolve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Letting a team dissolve with nobody knowing their destination is a reliable way to lose your best people.", what does "dissolve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: dissolve /dɪˈzɑːlv/ (động từ): tan rã. "A team dissolves" = đội tan rã; nghĩa gốc "sugar dissolves in water" = hòa tan.
items.explanationEn: dissolve /dɪˈzɑːlv/ (verb): to break up and end. "A team dissolves" means it breaks up; literally, sugar dissolves in water.

items.question: Trong câu "Letting a team dissolve with nobody knowing their destination is a reliable way to lose your best people.", từ "destination" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Letting a team dissolve with nobody knowing their destination is a reliable way to lose your best people.", what does "destination" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: destination /ˌdes.təˈneɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): nơi đến tiếp theo. Nghĩa bóng ở đây: vị trí/dự án tiếp theo của mỗi người; nghĩa gốc là điểm đến du lịch.
items.explanationEn: destination /ˌdes.təˈneɪ.ʃən/ (noun): the place someone goes next. Here, each person's next role or project; literally a travel destination.

items.question: Trong câu "Letting a team dissolve with nobody knowing their destination is a reliable way to lose your best people.", từ "reliable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Letting a team dissolve with nobody knowing their destination is a reliable way to lose your best people.", what does "reliable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: reliable /rɪˈlaɪ.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): chắc chắn, đáng tin. Câu mỉa: "a reliable way to lose" = cách chắc chắn sẽ mất người; danh từ: reliability.
items.explanationEn: reliable /rɪˈlaɪ.ə.bəl/ (adjective): dependable, always working. Used ironically: "a reliable way to lose" people; the noun is "reliability".

items.question: Trong câu "It sounds ceremonial, but it decides who wants to join your next project.", từ "ceremonial" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It sounds ceremonial, but it decides who wants to join your next project.", what does "ceremonial" (adjective) mean?
options: mang tính hình thức, nghi lễ
items.explanation: ceremonial /ˌser.əˈmoʊ.ni.əl/ (tính từ): mang tính hình thức, nghi lễ. Danh từ: ceremony (buổi lễ). Ý câu: ghi nhận công sức tưởng hình thức nhưng rất quan trọng.
items.explanationEn: ceremonial /ˌser.əˈmoʊ.ni.əl/ (adjective): done only for formality. From "ceremony"; recognising effort seems a formality but really matters.

items.question: Trong câu "a project stopped mid-flight still needs closing properly", từ "mid-flight" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "a project stopped mid-flight still needs closing properly", what does "mid-flight" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: mid-flight /ˌmɪdˈflaɪt/ (tính từ): đang giữa chừng. Nghĩa bóng: dừng khi đang làm dở; gần nghĩa "midway", "halfway through".
items.explanationEn: mid-flight /ˌmɪdˈflaɪt/ (adjective): partway through. Figuratively, stopped while still in progress; similar to "midway".

items.question: Trong câu "A cancelled project whose lessons were recorded is worth more than a cancelled project buried in silence.", từ "bury" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A cancelled project whose lessons were recorded is worth more than a cancelled project buried in silence.", what does "bury" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: bury /ˈber.i/ (động từ): chôn vùi, lấp đi. "Buried in silence" = bị chìm vào im lặng, không ai nhắc lại; phát âm giống "berry".
items.explanationEn: bury /ˈber.i/ (verb): to hide away and forget. "Buried in silence" means hidden away and never discussed; pronounced like "berry".

items.question: Trong câu "The five phases do not contradict agile — they are simply performed at a different cadence.", từ "contradict" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The five phases do not contradict agile — they are simply performed at a different cadence.", what does "contradict" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: contradict /ˌkɑːn.trəˈdɪkt/ (động từ): mâu thuẫn với. Danh từ: contradiction (mâu thuẫn); "contradict yourself" = tự nói mâu thuẫn.
items.explanationEn: contradict /ˌkɑːn.trəˈdɪkt/ (verb): to be in conflict with. The noun is "contradiction"; "contradict yourself" means saying opposite things.

items.question: Trong câu "The five phases do not contradict agile — they are simply performed at a different cadence.", từ "perform" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The five phases do not contradict agile — they are simply performed at a different cadence.", what does "perform" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: perform /pɚˈfɔːrm/ (động từ): thực hiện. "Perform a task" = thực hiện nhiệm vụ; "the app performs well" lại nói về hiệu năng.
items.explanationEn: perform /pɚˈfɔːrm/ (verb): to carry out. "Perform a task" means carry it out; "the app performs well" is about speed.

items.question: Trong câu "The five phases do not contradict agile — they are simply performed at a different cadence.", từ "cadence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The five phases do not contradict agile — they are simply performed at a different cadence.", what does "cadence" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the rise and fall of a voice
the end of a musical phrase
items.explanation: cadence /ˈkeɪ.dəns/ (danh từ): nhịp độ lặp lại. Trong agile, "release cadence" = nhịp phát hành đều đặn (vd. hai tuần một lần).
items.explanationEn: cadence /ˈkeɪ.dəns/ (noun): a regular rhythm or frequency. In agile, "release cadence" is how regularly you ship, e.g. every two weeks.

items.question: Trong câu "What does not change between the two models: you still need to know why the project exists, who is accountable, what risks are hanging, and how you will know you are done.", từ "accountable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What does not change between the two models: you still need to know why the project exists, who is accountable, what risks are hanging, and how you will know you are done.", what does "accountable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: accountable /əˈkaʊn.t̬ə.bəl/ (tính từ): chịu trách nhiệm cuối cùng. "Be accountable for something" = chịu trách nhiệm giải trình về điều gì.
items.explanationEn: accountable /əˈkaʊn.t̬ə.bəl/ (adjective): answerable for the result. "Be accountable for something" means you must answer for it.

items.question: Trong câu "How to choose: clear and stable scope, heavy compliance requirements, a fixed-price contract → lean traditional.", từ "compliance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How to choose: clear and stable scope, heavy compliance requirements, a fixed-price contract → lean traditional.", what does "compliance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: compliance /kəmˈplaɪ.əns/ (danh từ): sự tuân thủ quy định. "Compliance requirements" = yêu cầu tuân thủ (luật, chuẩn ngành); động từ: comply with.
items.explanationEn: compliance /kəmˈplaɪ.əns/ (noun): following rules and laws. "Compliance requirements" come from laws or standards; the verb is "comply with".

items.question: Trong câu "How to choose: clear and stable scope, heavy compliance requirements, a fixed-price contract → lean traditional.", từ "fixed-price" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How to choose: clear and stable scope, heavy compliance requirements, a fixed-price contract → lean traditional.", what does "fixed-price" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: fixed-price /ˌfɪkstˈpraɪs/ (tính từ): trọn gói giá cố định. "Fixed-price contract" = hợp đồng trọn gói; khác "time and materials" (tính theo công).
items.explanationEn: fixed-price /ˌfɪkstˈpraɪs/ (adjective): with a set total cost. A "fixed-price contract" differs from "time and materials", which bills by effort.

items.question: Trong câu "How to choose: clear and stable scope, heavy compliance requirements, a fixed-price contract → lean traditional.", từ "lean" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How to choose: clear and stable scope, heavy compliance requirements, a fixed-price contract → lean traditional.", what does "lean" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: lean /liːn/ (động từ): nghiêng về (lựa chọn). "Lean towards X" = có xu hướng chọn X; tính từ "lean" = gầy hoặc tinh gọn (lean startup).
items.explanationEn: lean /liːn/ (verb): to tend towards a choice. "Lean towards X" means to favour X; the adjective means thin or streamlined.

items.question: Trong câu "Most real projects sit in between and run a hybrid.", từ "hybrid" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Most real projects sit in between and run a hybrid.", what does "hybrid" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: hybrid /ˈhaɪ.brɪd/ (danh từ): mô hình lai kết hợp. "Hybrid model / hybrid work" = mô hình lai / làm việc kết hợp văn phòng và từ xa.
items.explanationEn: hybrid /ˈhaɪ.brɪd/ (noun): a mix of two approaches. "Hybrid model / hybrid work" combines two approaches, e.g. office and remote.

items.question: Trong câu "Phasing exists to create decision points, limit damage, and clarify accountability.", từ "clarify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Phasing exists to create decision points, limit damage, and clarify accountability.", what does "clarify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: clarify /ˈkler.ə.faɪ/ (động từ): làm rõ. "Clarify roles / requirements" = làm rõ vai trò / yêu cầu; danh từ: clarification.
items.explanationEn: clarify /ˈkler.ə.faɪ/ (verb): to make clear. "Clarify roles / requirements"; the noun is "clarification".

items.question: Trong câu "Initiation needs a business problem, measurable success criteria, a sponsor with authority, and recorded constraints.", từ "measurable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Initiation needs a business problem, measurable success criteria, a sponsor with authority, and recorded constraints.", what does "measurable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: measurable /ˈmeʒ.ɚ.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): đo lường được. Chữ "M" trong mục tiêu SMART là Measurable.
items.explanationEn: measurable /ˈmeʒ.ɚ.ə.bəl/ (adjective): able to be measured. It is the "M" in SMART goals.

items.question: Trong câu "Initiation needs a business problem, measurable success criteria, a sponsor with authority, and recorded constraints.", từ "constraint" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Initiation needs a business problem, measurable success criteria, a sponsor with authority, and recorded constraints.", what does "constraint" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: constraint /kənˈstreɪnt/ (danh từ): ràng buộc, giới hạn. Ràng buộc dự án điển hình: phạm vi, thời gian, chi phí ("triple constraint").
items.explanationEn: constraint /kənˈstreɪnt/ (noun): a limiting condition. Typical project constraints are scope, time and cost, the "triple constraint".

items.question: Trong câu "Assuming 100 percent allocation is wrong — 60 to 70 percent is realistic.", từ "allocation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Assuming 100 percent allocation is wrong — 60 to 70 percent is realistic.", what does "allocation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: allocation /ˌæl.əˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự phân bổ (nguồn lực). "Resource allocation" = phân bổ nguồn lực; trong lập trình "memory allocation" = cấp phát bộ nhớ.
items.explanationEn: allocation /ˌæl.əˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): assigning a share of resources. "Resource allocation" in PM; in programming, "memory allocation".

items.question: Trong câu "Initiation decides whether the project should exist, and rushing into detailed planning is the costliest mistake.", từ "rush into" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Initiation decides whether the project should exist, and rushing into detailed planning is the costliest mistake.", what does "rush into" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: rush into /rʌʃ ˈɪn.tuː/ (cụm từ): vội vã lao vào. "Rush into a decision" = quyết định vội vàng; câu khuyên "Don't rush into it."
items.explanationEn: rush into /rʌʃ ˈɪn.tuː/ (phrase): to start too hastily. "Rush into a decision" means deciding too quickly; as in "Don't rush into it."

items.question: Trong câu "Lessons must answer what we will do DIFFERENTLY, not list compliments.", từ "compliment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Lessons must answer what we will do DIFFERENTLY, not list compliments.", what does "compliment" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: compliment /ˈkɑːm.plə.mənt/ (danh từ): lời khen. Dễ nhầm với "complement" (phần bổ sung) vì phát âm gần giống.
items.explanationEn: compliment /ˈkɑːm.plə.mənt/ (noun): an expression of praise. Easily confused with "complement" (something that completes), which sounds similar.
